component.name: Unpack
component.summary: Explore and extract archives in a native interface

description.p: Browse, inspect, create and extract archives with a native GTK interface and structural validation of downloaded files.

This sandboxed Flatpak edition does not install or launch portable applications on the host and cannot register their desktop launchers. Use the native or AppImage edition for portable application installation. Downloads is accessible; other files and extraction folders must be selected through the system file chooser.
